§ 01 · The Program

A complete
curriculum.

Every passage is written for true B2 upper-intermediate learners — substantial, argument-driven texts spanning society and global issues, business and economy, travel and sustainability, technology and media, and psychology and personal growth. Each one is paired with eight carefully written comprehension questions, testing genuine command of nuance, inference, and the full spectrum of perspective a well-argued text contains. Built for use inside classrooms, self-study programs, and upper-intermediate English courses.

PERCEIVE

Authentic content

Every passage reflects real, natural B2-level English drawn from genuinely substantive contemporary issues.

DISTINGUISH

CEFR-aligned

Structured for true B2 comprehension — layered argument, nuanced perspective, and genuinely complex vocabulary.

INTERPRET

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with a clear answer key showing exactly which choice was correct and why.

INTEGRATE

Progress tracking

Your completed passages and scores are saved automatically, so you can revisit and improve over time.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Reading Comprehension Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for learners at every level. Spectrum takes its name from the full range of perspective genuine B2 reading demands — the ability to hold multiple viewpoints in mind at once, rather than reducing a text to a single simple meaning.

Designed for B2 learners ready for real argument and nuance — Spectrum is more than exercises. It's a wider range of understanding: the point where a learner starts to read not just for facts, but for the subtle shades of meaning between them.
